snippet.title: Bowerland Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Bowerland, the single-player euchre-inspired roguelite card battler now has a free demo you can try on Steam!

Free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4819630/Bowerland?utm_source=youtube

Wishlist today to be notified when the game launches later this year!

Call trump, take tricks, and deliver damage as you carve your way through the Bower King's sinister henchmen to take back the lands. Use banner modifiers and multi-select bonuses to grow your attacks and blocks to take down your opponents.
